context:
Goal: only the batch runner merges, through the merge tool.
Problem (risk): settings.json allows Bash(gh pr merge:*) with no record, so a lane or coordinator can merge on a bare call that only the CI check judges.
Based on (read): settings.json:11 holds "Bash(gh pr merge:*)"; no file in docs/decisions records it.
Based on (read): docs/decisions/auto-mode-owner-acts.md says it is the one home of every allow entry and forbids a broad class.
Based on (read): docs/decisions/session-tiers.md:106: hooks/guard_merge.py judges a raw merge on CI only; the coordinator's no-merge ruling is not enforced there (debt merge-role-skips-raw-merge).
Departs from: main, with an unrecorded allow for raw merges — removes it, or records it.

options.gain: No lane or coordinator merges on a bare call without a prompt; closes part of the raw-merge gap.
options.how: Drop Bash(gh pr merge:*) from settings.json. A raw merge then prompts; the merge tool's own allow rules stay.
options.label: Remove the allow entry
options.lose: A session that does run a raw merge now waits on a prompt.

options.gain: Nothing changes in how sessions merge; the allow gets its record.
options.how: Add an entry to auto-mode-owner-acts: the measured command, and a 'Never covers' sentence.
options.label: Keep it and record it
options.lose: Any session still merges on a bare call, judged on CI only.

ref: deep audit 1102, report docs/plans/deep-audit/report.md on audit/deep-1102 (6b6a41f3), table 'claude-settings: homes', row raw-merge-allow-rule

title: Remove the settings entry that lets any session run a raw gh pr merge with no prompt?
why: Only the batch runner merges, through the merge tool; a raw allow is the one path around that.
